1936, April
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 107 Cont.
Apr. 15 Peter LeDuc - 36 - of Toledo, stroke was here about a yr. ago. decidedly better but still not well ... John Hodges - 62 -threatened with blindness.
Is
Josephine Britton - 40 - (about) bitter against religion for some time - now reconciled but not expected to live.
Page 108
Apr. 18 Anna Soderlund - 52 - brain tuomer
21 Mrs. C. Harley - 70 - Goitre ...
22 Mrs. Douras - elderly lady - wants flat or house with 5 or 6 rooms - will call - in small white house across from Mr. El. C.
Loretta Roach - 20 - persists in keeping undesirable company ...
Sheila McKenna .. about 20 now.
Mrs. M. Walker - 26 - not well - mystery to doctors - has one little girl 1 yr. old.
Joseph Harry J. Kohls - 40 - fearful asthma Loraine Gowenlock - 21 - blind father non C ..... very hopeful. Elderly woran - take nerveous
Page 109 Apr. 29 Augusta Mrs. Bush - 60 - had stroke six weeks ago - quite helpless - folks asks prayers.
Margaret Nolan unjustly discharged ( from Kerns) E'd Hamel - 14 - orphan ran away from Father's Sister last July . ... Mrs. Emma Casey .... Goitre ... Heart Mrs. Leo Brewer - 39 - threatened with cancer inward - has mother 80 & father 84 - anxious about them, therefore hopes to escape operation
